messages.cli.help.description:
Agent Bullpen — a live dashboard for the multi-agent sessions of Claude Code and Codex.

It only reads: the session transcripts Claude Code leaves (~/.claude/projects/<proj>/<session>.jsonl)
and the transcripts of the agents it starts (agent-*.jsonl and *.meta.json files kept next to the session file).
A web page shows how the orchestrator and its agents are doing and the state of each debate
(topic × round × participant). Standard library only. It never writes to any transcript.

    python3 server.py                      # the most recent session that started agents (else the most recent plain conversation)
    python3 server.py --session <id>       # a given session
    python3 server.py --port 8790 --host 127.0.0.1
    python3 server.py --claude-config-dir ~/.claude --codex-home ~/.codex     # transcript folders (default: the standard environment variables, else ~/.claude and ~/.codex)
    python3 server.py --claude-usage-api   # query your Claude account's usage API (off by default: no credential file is read and there is no outside call)
    python3 server.py --lang ko            # language of the terminal output and --help (default auto: AGENT_BULLPEN_LANG → LC_ALL → LC_MESSAGES → LANG → en)
messages.cli.help.session: Session ID (UUID) to open when the URL names none. Default: the primary orchestration of the most recently active project, else the most recent plain conversation
messages.cli.help.host: Address to listen on; may be repeated (e.g. --host 127.0.0.1 --host <vpn-address>). Default 127.0.0.1. Only loopback, 100.64.0.0/10 (the range Tailscale/NetBird-style VPNs use) and fd7a:115c:a1e0::/48 (Tailscale IPv6) are accepted. Anything non-loopback prints a "no authentication" warning
messages.cli.help.allow_host: Extra names accepted in the Host header (may be repeated): a name (my.box) or a suffix (.example.net). Default: localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1 and the addresses given to --host. There is no built-in suffix. The port is ignored
messages.cli.help.claude_config_dir: Claude Code config folder (transcripts are read from DIR/projects). Default: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, else ~/.claude
messages.cli.help.codex_home: Codex folder (transcripts are read from DIR/sessions). Default: CODEX_HOME, else ~/.codex
messages.cli.help.lang: Language of the terminal output and --help (default auto: AGENT_BULLPEN_LANG → LC_ALL → LC_MESSAGES → LANG → en). Supported: {langs}
messages.cli.help.claude_usage_api: Query your Claude account's usage API for the plan bar (default off). When on, the server calls Anthropic's unofficial API every {sec} s with the token in .credentials.json in the Claude config folder. When off, no credential file is read and there is no outside call: only the .claude.json cache is used
messages.cli.help.no_link_cache: Do not keep the certain links (found by process lineage, environment, an output file or a long matching instruction: child and parent session ids, rule and time) in a file. Default: kept in links.json under the agent-bullpen folder of XDG_CACHE_HOME (default ~/.cache), so a restart does not forget them.
